catalogue.name: The Unseelie Court
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: The Alchemist’s Best
sharedRules.description: Unit gets Move(fleet) until end of turn, one use.

sharedRules.name: Blink belt
sharedRules.description: Model may attack aircraft/VTOL with CC weapons at range 18” with antiair (do not move model).

sharedRules.name: Strength From Suffering
sharedRules.description: Strength from Suffering: For every two (2) remaining enemy action markers in the endphase (after all removals), remove one (1) extra action marker from any friendly unit.

sharedRules.name: Do you know how we got these scars?!
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Secret paths of the world: return one (1) friendly unit to staging.
● Combat drugs: 1 friendly regular unit gets First strike(CC) until end of turn.
● Reign of dread: use in the endphase when removing action markers. One (1) enemy unit may not remove its last action marker.

sharedRules.name: Contract
sharedRules.description: Use when activating: model gets Assassin vs one (1) specific enemy model, one use.

sharedRules.name: Attach(raider, elite raider, cc raider, elite cc raider, torturers)
Close Combat Cult
sharedRules.description:
1x Unseelie Elite CC Raider unit does not count as a special choice.
Your Command choice must be a Tempter. You may not field more Unseelie Raider units than Unseelie Close Combat Raider units.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Bloodsports: the attack of one (1) friendly unit gets savage strike until end of turn.
● Uncanny dodge: 1 friendly unit has Target(potshots) vs blast and spray attacks until end of turn.
● Cavalcade of Murder: use when an enemy unit within 2” of one of your units makes a withdrawal move or is wiped out with CC attacks. Your unit may make a 6” move.

sharedRules.name: Alchemy Cult
sharedRules.description:
1x Unseelie Freaks OR Unseelie Torturers does not count as a special choice.
Your Command choice must be an Alchemist. You may not field more of other special units than Unseelie Freaks and Torturer units.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● The right stuff for the job: 1 friendly regular unit gets wound(re-roll) until end of turn.
● I know my art!: use before rolling from the Alchemy mystic school. Your result is automatically doubled.
● Freakish resilience: use after an enemy to-wound roll vs a friendly regular unit. It has Defence(re- roll) for this attack.

sharedRules.name: Hidden Doctrines
sharedRules.description: Hidden Doctrines don't inforce the doctrine force build rules. This will be updated in the future, but for now you will have to keep track of the doctrine force build rules.
